# Inline text

A line with *emphasis*, **strong**, ***both***, ~~strikethrough~~ and `inline code` side by side.

A [link](https://example.org/) in a sentence, a [link with `code` in it](https://example.org/code), and an autolink https://example.com/path in the middle of a line.

A long paragraph so that links, code and strikethrough fall on wrapped lines. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua, and then a [link that wraps across the end of a line because it has many words in its text](https://example.org/wrapped) and some `inline code that also might wrap if it is long enough` followed by ~~struck text that continues for a while so that it too wraps over lines~~ and the sentence ends.

Mixed sizes in one line: # not a heading, `code`, **bold `bold code`**, *italic **bold italic** italic*.

Hard break with two spaces  
second line, and a backslash break\
third line.

Escapes: \*not emphasis\*, \`not code\`, 1\. not a list, and an entity: &amp; &lt; &copy;.

Unicode: café, naïve, 日本語のテキスト, Ελληνικά, Привет, and an emoji 🙂.

Email <someone@example.com> and a bare URL https://example.net/.
